detailed_sections.composition: Each dose contains inactivated rabies virus strain Pasteur RIV.
detailed_sections.indications: For active immunization of dogs and cats against rabies.
detailed_sections.dose_and_administration: Administer 1 ml subcutaneously. Primary vaccination: 1 dose at 12 weeks of age. Booster: annually.
detailed_sections.precautions: Store in refrigerator. Do not freeze.
detailed_sections.pregnancy: Safe for use in pregnant animals.
detailed_sections.side_effects: Mild local reactions may occur at injection site.
detailed_sections.storage: Store between 2°C and 8°C. Protect from light.
detailed_sections.contraindications: Do not use in animals with fever or acute infections.
detailed_sections.interactions: May be administered simultaneously with other vaccines.
detailed_sections.overdose: No adverse effects expected from overdose.
detailed_sections.policy_of_ordering_shipping: Orders shipped within 24 hours. Express delivery available.
detailed_sections.delivery: Standard delivery: 3-5 business days. Express: 1-2 business days.
detailed_sections.return: Returns accepted within 30 days of purchase if unopened.

detailed_sections.indications: For the treatment and prevention of flea and tick infestations in dogs and cats.
detailed_sections.dose_and_administration: Apply topically once monthly. Part the hair and apply directly to skin.
detailed_sections.precautions: Do not bathe animal for 48 hours after application.
detailed_sections.pregnancy: Safe for use in pregnant and lactating animals.
detailed_sections.storage: Store at room temperature. Keep out of reach of children.
detailed_sections.contraindications: Do not use in puppies or kittens under 8 weeks of age.
detailed_sections.warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.
detailed_sections.policy_of_ordering_shipping: Free shipping on orders over 500 EGP.
detailed_sections.return: Returns accepted within 14 days if unopened.
